create_pdf_backend: create a PdfDocumentBackend instance to parse a PDF or image file for document processing
build_pdf_page_backend: build a PdfPageBackend to extract text, images, and layout information from a PDF page
run_get_text_in_rect: run get_text_in_rect to extract text within a specified bounding box on a PDF page
run_get_segmented_page: run get_segmented_page to retrieve a SegmentedPdfPage with structured text and layout data
run_get_text_cells: run get_text_cells to iterate over all text cells on a PDF page with bounding box coordinates
run_get_bitmap_rects: run get_bitmap_rects to find all bitmap/image regions on a PDF page
run_get_page_image: run get_page_image to render a PDF page as a PIL Image with optional scaling and cropping
run_load_page: run load_page to load a specific page from a PDF document as a PdfPageBackend instance
run_page_count: run page_count to determine the total number of pages in a PDF document
run_supported_formats: run supported_formats to check which input formats the PdfDocumentBackend accepts
